Definition: Hor, the name of a peak in Idumaea and of one in Syria
BiblicalUsage: Hor = "mountain"; 1) the mountain on which Aaron died; situated on the eastern side of the valley of Arabah, the highest of the whole range of sandstone mountains in Edom; on the eastern side is the ancient city of Petra; 2) the mountain named as one of the marks of the northern boundary of the land which the children of Israel were about to conquer; located in Lebanon
